desc_en: Experience pristine white sand beaches, turquoise waves, and vibrant sunset dining along Mogadishu's coastline.
desc_so: Khibrad u yeelo xeebaha ciidda cad, mawjadaha buluugga ah, iyo cashada fiidkii ee xeebta Muqdisho.

title_so: Sahanka Sawirada Qadiimiga ah ee Laas Geel
desc_en: Journey 5,000 years back into ancient African rock art hidden within granite rock formations.
desc_so: U socdaal 5,000 sano ka hor sawirada dhagaxyada qadiimiga ah ee ku yaal Laas Geel.

desc_en: Trek through misty pine forests, rare frankincense groves, and dramatic clifftop panoramic viewpoints.
desc_so: Ku socdaal kaymaha buuraha Daallo, geedaha beeyada, iyo muuqaallada caabuqa leh ee Cal Madow.

desc_en: Savor authentic Bariis Isku-karis, Suqaar, Camel Milk tea, and fresh seafood infused with aromatic spices.
desc_so: Dhadhami bariiska isku-kariska ah, suqaarka, shaaha caanaha geela, iyo kalluunka cusub.

desc_en: Immerse yourself in traditional rhythmic Dhaanto dance performances and soul-stirring Somali poetry recitations.
desc_so: Daawo ciyaaraha dhaantada iyo habeenada gabayada hiddaha iyo dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed.

title_so: Sawirada Dhismaha Qadiimiga ah ee Xeebaha
desc_en: Capture historic Italian-Somali archways, coastal lighthouses, and bustling morning fish markets.
desc_so: Sawir dhismayaasha qadiimiga ah, laydhka xeebaha, iyo suuqyada kalluunka ee waajibaadka subaxnimo.
